data.one_liner: FormBuilder field widget to pick images from gallery or camera.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FormBuilder-compatible field that lets users select images from the device gallery or camera. The selected images are returned as Uint8List, XFile, URL string, or ImageProvider. Supports multiple platforms and multiple image selection.
use_when: You need an image input inside a flutter_form_builder form
You want a ready‑made picker that works on mobile, web and desktop
You need to store selected images in various formats
avoid_when: You require advanced image editing or cropping beyond basic selection
strengths: Supports gallery, camera and multiple platforms
Allows different return types (Uint8List, XFile, URL, ImageProvider)
weaknesses: Relies on image_picker for native functionality
Limited customization of the picker UI
data.setup_notes: Follow image_picker platform setup (add permissions for Android/iOS, configure web, macOS, Windows, Linux as per image_picker docs)

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides raw image picking without the FormBuilder wrapper, useful if you don't need form integration
